messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "patients younger than 18 years old"
set: ["patients younger than 18 years old", "individuals younger than 18 years old", "individuals younger than 18 years old with breathing problems", "patients younger than 18 years old with recent tonsil or adenoid surgery", "children younger than 12 years old", "children younger than 6 months old", "younger than 12 years of age", "fibromyalgia in children 13 years old or older", "patients taking higher than recommended doses", "old infection", "anxiety in adults and children at least 7 years old", "general anxiety disorder in children 7 years old or older", "patients without an ejection fraction less than 40%", "asthma attacks in adults and children at least 2 years old", "major depressive disorder in adults and adolescents at least 12 years old", "children under 18 years of age after surgery to remove the tonsils and/or adenoids"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
